title: Comparison-only magnitude selects have qualified native tl.abs headroom on C550

verified_by.software_gates: 2467 passed, 26 skips, 8917 subtests; focused 11/10; unchanged Corpus passed; all five CI checks passed

observation: The generated bucketed recipe contains 32 select(compare(x,0,ge),x,mul(x,-1)) expressions whose results have only numerical COMPARE readers. Replacing only their emitted native-source spelling by tl.abs preserves all magnitude masks, dot order, Neumaier arithmetic and launch. C550-2 job maca-d27ec7d1dae5 passes all 37 NT v2 cases with unchanged inputs, zero tolerance failures and maximum absolute error 0.015625. Quality-passed paired search maca-1b60d9a559d1 is 10.240/11.520 us (1.125x); fresh confirmation maca-8f09c4b25b69 is 10.496/11.520 us (1.0976x); both win 10/10 reversed pairs, 250 samples per arm. Baseline A/A maca-4c0d31b801d1 is close-null at 11.776/11.520 us, quality passed, 0/9 wins and one tie. All 60 raw cohorts replay through native MCPTI validation and paired_summary. Separate profile maca-d12b44da6f9e has correct instrumented output, 178 registers/thread, 4096 dynamic shared bytes, zero static shared and independently queried function-local bytes. Native ELF shrinks from 30232 to 26136 bytes; TTGIR changes from 63 compares/zero abs to 31 compares/32 abs, retaining 16 dots. These are authored-source receipts, not a Compiler-generated successor score. Allocation is local_serialized; external activity is not excluded, and occupancy/bandwidth/ISA counters were not collected.
semantic_boundary: CPU exhaustive checks cover all 65536 FP16 encodings, 11 thresholds, all six numeric comparisons and both operand orders (8650752 relations), plus 16 FP32 boundary words including signed zeros, subnormals, normals, infinities and NaNs. Stored negative zero is a counterexample: the existing select returns 80000000 while abs returns 00000000. Float sign/payload differences are unobservable only through the modeled numerical comparisons; floating exception flags are not modeled. This CPU argument is not a device special-value audit.
proposed_change: Implement a guarded MACA emitter spelling in compiler/backends/metax.py, used by shared Triton SELECT emission. Match typed non-scalar FP16/FP32 register values, zero GE predicate and exact -1 multiplication, unique producers in the same role/region, and scratch selected results with only numerical COMPARE readers. Reject optimization for outputs, stores, arithmetic/casts, indirect or other semantic references, unsupported dtypes, instruction/broadcast overrides and ambiguous writers/regions. Preserve ordinary SELECT emission for those legal counterexamples. Establish a special-value device boundary before widening beyond the measured finite Workload. No new IR operation, instruction contract, dtype, layout or Target hardware fact is proposed.
principles: P1 retains existing arithmetic authoring; P2 makes emitted tl.abs inspectable; P3 adds no second IR operation for the same compare projection; P4/P5/P7 derive legality from typed producers, consumers and semantic references without changing effects; P6 requires positive and guard-owned negative emission checks, unchanged other-vendor emission, full Corpus/contracts at a fixed clean commit and successor device requalification; P8 binds the spelling and measured benefit to the captured C550-2 runtime, retaining missing profiler coverage.
promotion_disposition: Accepted guarded MACA emitter spelling after fixed-commit software gates, special-value comparison/stored-zero device audit and Compiler-generated all-case/search/fresh confirmation/A-A/profile qualification. Generated search and confirmation both 10.496/11.520 us (1.0976x); native authored-source score remains distinct. Comparison-only semantics, captured C550-2 runtime and fixed Workload performance scope; no stored magnitude, raw NaN payload or exception-flag equivalence claim.
